desc:
🌈 WELCOME TO SUZY SAYS!  Officiel Games ⭐

🏠 After a fun evening at your friend's house, you return home to discover a mysterious interactive DVD game waiting for you...

👧 Meet Suzy! A cheerful girl who's excited to play with you!

🎮 Step onto the colorful interactive floor mat and get ready for a twisted game of Simon Says!

🌟 Listen carefully to Suzy's instructions.
🎯 Follow the rules and complete the challenges.
⚡ React quickly and avoid making mistakes.
😱 Discover what happens when Suzy gets upset!

💀 But beware... Suzy doesn't like losing, and she REALLY doesn't like being disappointed!

🎀 Can you survive Suzy's game?

⚠️ REMEMBER: LISTEN CAREFULLY, FOLLOW THE RULES, AND NEVER DISAPPOINT SUZY!

👍 LIKE the game if you enjoy it!
⭐ FAVORITE to support future updates!
👥 Invite your friends to play!
